Hi all — attaching the requested artifacts and a short summary here. Attachments: redwood_privatelink_topology_v2.pdf, redwood_residency_statement_EU_signed.pdf, soc2-summary-2026Q2.pdf.

Summary / technical notes (TL;DR):
- EU-only hosting: HealthGrid tenant will be pinned to our eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 node pools. Production inference and KV cache persistence are configured in-region; no cross-border egress for live tokens. The attached signed residency statement documents the binding.
- PrivateLink topology: The topology PDF shows the PrivateLink acceptor in the customer's VPC peering to a regional PrivateLink endpoint in eu-west-1. Traffic terminates on dedicated VPCs for Dedicated and Private customers; keys are customer-optional (we can integrate with your KMS).
- Fallback behavior: In rare regional capacity exhaustion, our routing policy can failover to a compatible EU-only standby pool (same EU regions). We will not failover to non-EU regions unless explicitly authorized in writing. The residency statement includes the fallback policy language.
- SOC 2: included is a cover summary with scope and auditor contact. Full SOC packet can be provided via secure share for Procurement.

Operational items for HealthGrid (short):
- Please confirm the peering CIDR(s) you plan to use so we can validate no overlap with our acceptor prefixes.
- Provide the primary Admin contact for DocuSign signature.

If you want, I can also export the minimal CAIQ slice for network/security questions; that will be available by 09/10.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
